## 背景

Bootstrap CI 对 item 做 resampling，但重复抽样的 items 违反独立性。Delete-1 Jackknife 不重复抽样，如果两种方法的 CI 宽度接近，说明 bootstrap 结果 robust。

## 实现

在服务器上直接运行分析（不需要修改现有代码文件）：

import pandas as pd

all_records = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob("results/exp001_llama/shard_*.jsonl")):
    with open(f) as fh:
        for line in fh:
            all_records.append(json.loads(line))

df = pd.DataFrame(all_records)
df["answer_logprob"] = df["answer_logprob"].replace(-np.inf, np.nan)
print(f"Loaded {len(df)} records, {df['item_id'].nunique()} unique items")

from src.analysis.variance_decomposition import estimate_variance_components

facets = ["precision", "temperature", "prompt_template", "seed", "ordering", "item_id"]
items = sorted(df["item_id"].unique())
n_items = len(items)

# === Bootstrap (1000 resamples) ===
print("\n=== Bootstrap (1000 resamples, item-level) ===")
np.random.seed(42)
n_boot = 1000
boot_results = []

for b in range(n_boot):
    if b % 100 == 0:
        print(f"  Bootstrap {b}/{n_boot}...")
    sampled_items = np.random.choice(items, size=n_items, replace=True)
    # Build resampled dataset
    boot_dfs = []
    for new_idx, item in enumerate(sampled_items):
        sub = df[df["item_id"] == item].copy()
        sub["item_id"] = f"item_{new_idx}"  # Unique ID for resampled item
        boot_dfs.append(sub)
    boot_df = pd.concat(boot_dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    try:
        vc = estimate_variance_components(boot_df, facets, "correct")
        total = sum(vc.values())
        if total > 0:
            boot_results.append({k: v/total*100 for k, v in vc.items()})
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Bootstrap {b} failed: {e}")
        continue

print(f"  Completed {len(boot_results)}/{n_boot} bootstrap resamples")

# Bootstrap CIs
boot_df_results = pd.DataFrame(boot_results)
boot_ci = {}
for col in boot_df_results.columns:
    lo = np.percentile(boot_df_results[col], 2.5)
    hi = np.percentile(boot_df_results[col], 97.5)
    mean = boot_df_results[col].mean()
    boot_ci[col] = {"mean": round(mean, 3), "ci_lo": round(lo, 3), "ci_hi": round(hi, 3), "width": round(hi - lo, 3)}

print("\nBootstrap CIs (top components):")
for k in sorted(boot_ci.keys(), key=lambda x: -boot_ci[x]["mean"])[:10]:
    ci = boot_ci[k]
    print(f"  {k}: {ci['mean']:.1f}% [{ci['ci_lo']:.1f}, {ci['ci_hi']:.1f}] (width={ci['width']:.1f})")

# === Jackknife (delete-1 item) ===
print(f"\n=== Jackknife (delete-1, {n_items} iterations) ===")
jack_results = []

for i, drop_item in enumerate(items):
    if i % 20 == 0:
        print(f"  Jackknife {i}/{n_items}...")
    jack_df = df[df["item_id"] != drop_item].copy()
    
    try:
        vc = estimate_variance_components(jack_df, facets, "correct")
        total = sum(vc.values())
        if total > 0:
            jack_results.append({k: v/total*100 for k, v in vc.items()})
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Jackknife {i} failed: {e}")
        continue

print(f"  Completed {len(jack_results)}/{n_items} jackknife iterations")

# Jackknife CIs (using pseudo-values)
jack_df_results = pd.DataFrame(jack_results)

# Point estimate
point_vc = estimate_variance_components(df, facets, "correct")
point_total = sum(point_vc.values())
point_pct = {k: v/point_total*100 for k, v in point_vc.items()}

jack_ci = {}
for col in jack_df_results.columns:
    # Pseudo-values: theta_hat_i = n * theta_hat - (n-1) * theta_hat_{-i}
    pseudo = n_items * point_pct.get(col, 0) - (n_items - 1) * jack_df_results[col].values
    mean_pseudo = pseudo.mean()
    se = np.std(pseudo, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n_items)
    lo = mean_pseudo - 1.96 * se
    hi = mean_pseudo + 1.96 * se
    jack_ci[col] = {"mean": round(mean_pseudo, 3), "ci_lo": round(lo, 3), "ci_hi": round(hi, 3), "width": round(hi - lo, 3)}

    ci = jack_ci[k]
    print(f"  {k}: {ci['mean']:.1f}% [{ci['ci_lo']:.1f}, {ci['ci_hi']:.1f}] (width={ci['width']:.1f})")

# === Comparison ===
print("\n=== Bootstrap vs Jackknife Comparison ===")
print(f"{'Component':<25} {'Boot Mean':>9} {'Boot Width':>10} {'Jack Mean':>9} {'Jack Width':>10} {'Ratio':>7}")
for comp in sorted(boot_ci.keys(), key=lambda x: -boot_ci[x]["mean"])[:15]:
    b = boot_ci[comp]
    j = jack_ci.get(comp, {"mean": 0, "width": 0})
    ratio = b["width"] / j["width"] if j["width"] > 0 else float("inf")
    print(f"  {comp:<23} {b['mean']:>8.1f}% {b['width']:>9.1f}pp {j['mean']:>8.1f}% {j['width']:>9.1f}pp {ratio:>6.2f}")

# 保存
output = {
    "bootstrap": {"n_resamples": len(boot_results), "ci": boot_ci},
    "jackknife": {"n_iterations": len(jack_results), "ci": jack_ci},

print("\n=== 1. Rasch Model (1PL) ===")

item_map = {item: i for i, item in enumerate(items)}

    j = item_map[row["item_id"]]
    response_matrix[i, j] = row["correct"]

# Rasch: P(X=1|theta_j, b_i) = logistic(theta_j - b_i)
# Joint MLE (simple iterative approach)

# Initialize
theta = np.zeros(n_conditions)  # condition ability
b = np.zeros(n_items)  # item difficulty

# Use item means as starting point for b
item_means = np.nanmean(response_matrix, axis=0)
b = -np.log(item_means / (1 - item_means + 1e-10))  # logit transform

# Iterative estimation (simplified JMLE)
for iteration in range(20):
    # Update theta given b
    for j in range(n_conditions):
        observed = response_matrix[j, :]
        valid = ~np.isnan(observed)
        if valid.sum() == 0:

        def neg_ll_theta(t):
            p = expit(t - b[valid])
            return -np.sum(observed[valid] * np.log(p + 1e-10) + (1 - observed[valid]) * np.log(1 - p + 1e-10))
        result = minimize(neg_ll_theta, theta[j], method="Nelder-Mead")
        theta[j] = result.x[0]
    
    # Update b given theta

        observed = response_matrix[:, i]
        valid = ~np.isnan(observed)
        if valid.sum() == 0:

        ll = np.sum(response_matrix[valid_mask] * np.log(p_matrix[valid_mask] + 1e-10) +

item_difficulty = -np.log(p_items / (1 - p_items))

p_persons = np.clip(p_persons, 0.01, 0.99)
person_ability = np.log(p_persons / (1 - p_persons))

for iteration in range(10):
    # Update item difficulty
    for j in range(n_items):
        expected = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(person_ability - item_difficulty[j])))
        residual = response_matrix[:, j].sum() - expected.sum()
        item_difficulty[j] -= residual / (expected * (1 - expected)).sum() * 0.5
    
    # Update person ability
    for i in range(n_persons):
        expected = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(person_ability[i] - item_difficulty)))
        residual = response_matrix[i, :].sum() - expected.sum()
        person_ability[i] += residual / (expected * (1 - expected)).sum() * 0.5

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path

df = pd.read_csv("results/analysis/llama_full.csv")
print(f"Loaded {len(df)} records")

facets = ["precision", "temperature", "prompt_template", "seed", "ordering", "item_id"]
n = {f: df[f].nunique() for f in facets}
N = len(df)

def variance_decomposition(df, metric, fixed_facets=None):
    """G-theory variance decomposition with optional fixed facets."""
    if fixed_facets is None:
        fixed_facets = set()
    
    grand_mean = df[metric].mean()
    SS_total = ((df[metric] - grand_mean) ** 2).sum()
    
    components = {}
    
    # Main effects
    for f in facets:
        means = df.groupby(f)[metric].mean()
        n_per = N // n[f]
        ss = n_per * ((means - grand_mean) ** 2).sum()
        components[f] = ss
    
    # 2-way interactions
    for f1, f2 in combinations(facets, 2):
        cell_means = df.groupby([f1, f2])[metric].mean()
        n_per = N // (n[f1] * n[f2])
        ss = 0
        for (l1, l2), cell_mean in cell_means.items():
            f1_mean = df.groupby(f1)[metric].mean()[l1]
            f2_mean = df.groupby(f2)[metric].mean()[l2]
            ss += n_per * (cell_mean - f1_mean - f2_mean + grand_mean) ** 2
        components[f"{f1}:{f2}"] = ss
    
    ss_explained = sum(components.values())
    components["residual"] = SS_total - ss_explained
    
    total_var = sum(components.values())
    pct = {k: v/total_var * 100 for k, v in components.items()}
    
    # G coefficient: tau = item_id, delta = random error sources only
    tau = pct.get("item_id", 0)
    # delta = all random components except item_id (and excluding fixed facets + their interactions)
    delta = 0
    for k, v in pct.items():
        if k == "item_id":
            continue
        # Skip if component involves any fixed facet
        parts = k.split(":")
        if any(p in fixed_facets for p in parts):
            continue
        delta += v
    
    G = tau / (tau + delta) if (tau + delta) > 0 else 0
    
    return {
        "components_pct": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in sorted(pct.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])},
        "G_coefficient": round(G, 4),
        "fixed_facets": list(fixed_facets),
        "tau_pct": round(tau, 4),
        "delta_pct": round(delta, 4),
    }

# Run sensitivity analysis for binary_correct
results = {"metric": "binary_correct", "analyses": {}}

# Scenario 1: All random (baseline)
print("=== Scenario 1: All random ===")
r = variance_decomposition(df, "correct", fixed_facets=set())
results["analyses"]["all_random"] = r
print(f"G = {r['G_coefficient']:.4f}, delta = {r['delta_pct']:.2f}%")

# Scenario 2: Temperature fixed
print("\n=== Scenario 2: Temperature fixed ===")
r = variance_decomposition(df, "correct", fixed_facets={"temperature"})
results["analyses"]["temperature_fixed"] = r
print(f"G = {r['G_coefficient']:.4f}, delta = {r['delta_pct']:.2f}%")

# Scenario 3: Ordering fixed
print("\n=== Scenario 3: Ordering fixed ===")
r = variance_decomposition(df, "correct", fixed_facets={"ordering"})
results["analyses"]["ordering_fixed"] = r
print(f"G = {r['G_coefficient']:.4f}, delta = {r['delta_pct']:.2f}%")

# Scenario 4: Precision fixed
print("\n=== Scenario 4: Precision fixed ===")
r = variance_decomposition(df, "correct", fixed_facets={"precision"})
results["analyses"]["precision_fixed"] = r
print(f"G = {r['G_coefficient']:.4f}, delta = {r['delta_pct']:.2f}%")

# Scenario 5: Temperature + Ordering + Precision fixed (most conservative)

r = variance_decomposition(df, "correct", fixed_facets={"temperature", "ordering", "precision"})

print(f"G = {r['G_coefficient']:.4f}, delta = {r['delta_pct']:.2f}%")

# Scenario 6: Temperature + Precision fixed

r = variance_decomposition(df, "correct", fixed_facets={"temperature", "precision"})

print(f"G = {r['G_coefficient']:.4f}, delta = {r['delta_pct']:.2f}%")

# Summary table

print("SUMMARY: G coefficient sensitivity to fixed/random choice")
print("="*60)
print(f"{'Scenario':<40s} {'G':>8s} {'Delta%':>8s}")
print("-"*60)
for name, r in results["analyses"].items():
    print(f"{name:<40s} {r['G_coefficient']:>8.4f} {r['delta_pct']:>8.2f}%")

# Also do text_exact_match

print("text_exact_match sensitivity")
print("="*60)

for scenario, fixed in [
    ("all_random", set()),
    ("temperature_fixed", {"temperature"}),
    ("temp_prec_fixed", {"temperature", "precision"}),

]:

## 背景
Bootstrap resampling items 可能因 item 重复导致独立性假设违反。Jackknife（delete-1）不重复采样，如果两者 CI 宽度接近，证明 bootstrap 结果 robust。

## 任务

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path

df = pd.read_csv("results/analysis/llama_full.csv")
print(f"Loaded {len(df)} records, {df['item_id'].nunique()} items")

facets = ["precision", "temperature", "prompt_template", "seed", "ordering", "item_id"]
n_facets = {f: df[f].nunique() for f in facets}
N = len(df)
items = sorted(df["item_id"].unique())
n_items = len(items)

def compute_variance_pct(subset_df, metric="correct"):
    """Compute variance decomposition percentages for a data subset."""
    grand_mean = subset_df[metric].mean()
    SS_total = ((subset_df[metric] - grand_mean) ** 2).sum()
    if SS_total == 0:
        return {}
    
    N_sub = len(subset_df)
    components = {}
    
    for f in facets:
        if f not in subset_df.columns:
            continue
        n_f = subset_df[f].nunique()
        if n_f <= 1:
            continue
        means = subset_df.groupby(f)[metric].mean()
        n_per = N_sub // n_f
        ss = n_per * ((means - grand_mean) ** 2).sum()
        components[f] = ss
    
    for f1, f2 in combinations(facets, 2):
        if f1 not in subset_df.columns or f2 not in subset_df.columns:
            continue
        n1 = subset_df[f1].nunique()
        n2 = subset_df[f2].nunique()
        if n1 <= 1 or n2 <= 1:
            continue
        cell_means = subset_df.groupby([f1, f2])[metric].mean()
        n_per = N_sub // (n1 * n2)
        ss = 0
        f1_means = subset_df.groupby(f1)[metric].mean()
        f2_means = subset_df.groupby(f2)[metric].mean()
        for (l1, l2), cell_mean in cell_means.items():
            ss += n_per * (cell_mean - f1_means[l1] - f2_means[l2] + grand_mean) ** 2
        components[f"{f1}:{f2}"] = ss
    
    ss_explained = sum(components.values())
    components["residual"] = max(0, SS_total - ss_explained)
    total = sum(components.values())
    return {k: v/total * 100 for k, v in components.items()}

# === BOOTSTRAP (1000 resamples) ===
print("Running bootstrap (1000 resamples)...")
np.random.seed(42)
boot_results = {comp: [] for comp in ["item_id", "residual", "precision", "temperature", 
                                       "prompt_template", "seed", "ordering",
                                       "precision:item_id", "temperature:item_id",
                                       "prompt_template:item_id", "seed:item_id"]}
n_boot = 1000
for b in range(n_boot):
    if b % 100 == 0:
        print(f"  Bootstrap {b}/{n_boot}")
    sampled_items = np.random.choice(items, size=n_items, replace=True)
    # Build resampled dataset
    frames = []
    for i, item in enumerate(sampled_items):
        sub = df[df["item_id"] == item].copy()
        sub["item_id"] = f"item_{i}"  # unique IDs for resampled items
        frames.append(sub)
    boot_df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    pct = compute_variance_pct(boot_df, "correct")
    for comp in boot_results:
        boot_results[comp].append(pct.get(comp, 0))

boot_ci = {}
for comp, vals in boot_results.items():
    vals = np.array(vals)
    boot_ci[comp] = {
        "mean": round(float(np.mean(vals)), 4),
        "ci_lower": round(float(np.percentile(vals, 2.5)), 4),
        "ci_upper": round(float(np.percentile(vals, 97.5)), 4),
        "ci_width": round(float(np.percentile(vals, 97.5) - np.percentile(vals, 2.5)), 4),
    }

print("\nBootstrap CIs (binary_correct):")
for comp, ci in sorted(boot_ci.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]["mean"]):
    if ci["mean"] >= 0.1:
        print(f"  {comp:30s}: {ci['mean']:7.2f}% [{ci['ci_lower']:.2f}, {ci['ci_upper']:.2f}] width={ci['ci_width']:.2f}")

# === JACKKNIFE (delete-1, 200 items) ===
print(f"\nRunning jackknife (delete-1, {n_items} iterations)...")
jack_results = {comp: [] for comp in boot_results}
for i, item_to_remove in enumerate(items):
    if i % 20 == 0:
        print(f"  Jackknife {i}/{n_items}")
    jack_df = df[df["item_id"] != item_to_remove]
    pct = compute_variance_pct(jack_df, "correct")
    for comp in jack_results:
        jack_results[comp].append(pct.get(comp, 0))

jack_ci = {}
for comp, vals in jack_results.items():
    vals = np.array(vals)
    theta_hat = np.mean(vals)
    # Jackknife SE
    n_j = len(vals)
    pseudo_vals = n_j * compute_variance_pct(df, "correct").get(comp, 0) - (n_j - 1) * vals
    jack_se = np.sqrt(np.var(pseudo_vals, ddof=1) / n_j)
    jack_ci[comp] = {
        "mean": round(float(theta_hat), 4),
        "ci_lower": round(float(theta_hat - 1.96 * jack_se), 4),
        "ci_upper": round(float(theta_hat + 1.96 * jack_se), 4),
        "ci_width": round(float(2 * 1.96 * jack_se), 4),
        "se": round(float(jack_se), 4),
    }

print("\nJackknife CIs (binary_correct):")
for comp, ci in sorted(jack_ci.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]["mean"]):
    if ci["mean"] >= 0.1:
        print(f"  {comp:30s}: {ci['mean']:7.2f}% [{ci['ci_lower']:.2f}, {ci['ci_upper']:.2f}] width={ci['ci_width']:.2f}")

# === COMPARISON ===
print("\n" + "="*70)
print("COMPARISON: Bootstrap vs Jackknife CI widths")
print("="*70)
print(f"{'Component':<30s} {'Boot Width':>10s} {'Jack Width':>10s} {'Ratio':>8s}")
print("-"*70)
for comp in sorted(boot_ci.keys(), key=lambda c: -boot_ci[c]["mean"]):
    bw = boot_ci[comp]["ci_width"]
    jw = jack_ci[comp]["ci_width"]
    ratio = bw / jw if jw > 0 else float('inf')
    if boot_ci[comp]["mean"] >= 0.1:
        print(f"{comp:<30s} {bw:>10.2f} {jw:>10.2f} {ratio:>8.2f}")

# Save
output = {
    "bootstrap": {"n_resamples": n_boot, "seed": 42, "components": boot_ci},
    "jackknife": {"n_items": n_items, "components": jack_ci},
}
Path("results/analysis").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with open("results/analysis/bootstrap_vs_jackknife.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(output, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f"\nSaved results/analysis/bootstrap_vs_jackknife.json")

r_spearman, p_spearman = stats.spearmanr(item_stats["bernoulli_var"], item_stats["var_correct"])

print("\n=== Rasch Model (1PL IRT) ===")

# In Rasch: P(correct|theta, b_i) = sigmoid(theta - b_i)

# Estimate item difficulties using marginal ML (proportion-based approximation)
# For each item: p_i = mean(correct) → b_i = -logit(p_i)
item_stats = df.groupby("item_id")["correct"].agg(["mean", "count"]).reset_index()
item_stats.columns = ["item_id", "p_correct", "n_obs"]

# Logit transform for difficulty
item_stats["difficulty_b"] = -np.log(item_stats["p_correct"] / (1 - item_stats["p_correct"]))
# Handle extremes
item_stats.loc[item_stats["p_correct"] >= 0.999, "difficulty_b"] = -5.0
item_stats.loc[item_stats["p_correct"] <= 0.001, "difficulty_b"] = 5.0

print("=== IRT Rasch Model (1PL) ===")

print(f"  Mean: {item_stats['difficulty_b'].mean():.4f}")
print(f"  Std: {item_stats['difficulty_b'].std():.4f}")
print(f"  Range: [{item_stats['difficulty_b'].min():.4f}, {item_stats['difficulty_b'].max():.4f}]")

# === 2. IRT Item Information ===
# For Rasch: I_i(theta) = P_i * (1 - P_i) = p_i * (1 - p_i)
item_stats["information"] = item_stats["p_correct"] * (1 - item_stats["p_correct"])

print(f"\nItem Information:")
print(f"  Mean: {item_stats['information'].mean():.4f}")
print(f"  Max (at p=0.5): {item_stats['information'].max():.4f}")

print(f"  Minimum items: {min_items_irt_avg}")
